title: Redesign enterprise security & compliance intake to reduce triage time and automate routing
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Customer requests for security and compliance artifacts (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires) are submitted through multiple channels (sales, support, account, email). Manual triage causes inconsistent prioritization, long response SLAs, duplicate work across teams, and missed tracking for contractual commitments.

Goal: Redesign the intake and prioritization flow so that security/compliance requests are: 1) captured consistently in a single intake pipeline, 2) scored automatically against a lightweight risk/priority rubric, 3) routed to the correct destinations (Security/GRC, Legal, Account Ops, Solutions Engineering) with clear SLAs, and 4) surfaced in Console and internal dashboards for tracking and reporting.

Scope: Intake form and API, priority scoring rules (customer size, contract clause, regulated industry, requested artifact type), mapping for SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires, automated routing rules, canned response templates, follow-up task generation, ownership handoff UI, and reporting metrics. This ticket covers the PM definition, vendor template library, routing matrix, and acceptance criteria; implementation tickets will be created in ENG/Design.

Non-goals: Replacing our full legal review process or changing audit content themselves. This is a triage and routing improvement to reduce lead time and surface required handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Single canonical intake endpoint documented and available to Sales/Support/GTM with sample API and form links
Priority scoring rubric defined (numeric) and documented with example cases for SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/Questionnaires
Routing matrix that maps request attributes to owner teams and SLA target (e.g., initial ack within 24h, artifact delivery within X days)
A library of standard response templates and commonly requested artifacts (SOC2 summary, Data Processing Addendum) linked in Confluence
Report/dashboard spec that shows open requests, SLA breaches, cycle time, and top request types
Security/GRC and Legal have reviewed and signed off on the routing and templates
Pilot intake integrated with Zendesk and internal Console; pilot with two enterprise accounts without manual handoffs
